kind.value: Social media management suite for agencies and multi-location brands, organised into client workspaces, with scheduling, bulk posting, monitoring and reports

hosting.value: Hosted; a white-label add-on on Elite and Enterprise rebrands the hosted product under the agency's own domain

pricingModel.value: Per workspace bundle rather than per user: every plan includes unlimited users, and each workspace comes with 6 social profiles. A stepper on the pricing page adds workspaces, each bringing 6 more profiles

freeOption.value: No free plan; the entry point is a 14-day trial
freeOption.note: The pricing page renders its prices and its workspace stepper in the browser, so these figures were read on the page itself with the stepper at one workspace.

trial.value: 14-day free trial, no card required, no contract

entryPaid.value: Core, $35/month on monthly billing, 1 workspace and 6 social profiles

plans.value: Core $35 (1 workspace / 6 profiles), Plus $99 (3 / 18), Premium $199 (7 / 42), Elite $299 (15 / 90), Enterprise $750 (50 / 300), all on monthly billing with unlimited users. Extra workspaces cost $35 a month on Core and $30 on Plus

3.note: Core's single workspace holds 6 profiles, more than enough for 3, with unlimited users.

10.note: Profiles come 6 to a workspace, so 10 needs 2 workspaces: Core's stepper shows $70. Plus at its 3-workspace default is $99, so Core is cheaper at this size.

30.note: 30 profiles need 5 workspaces. Read on the pricing page with its stepper at 5 workspaces: Core shows $175 while Plus shows $159, so the larger plan is the cheaper one here, and it adds assignment and approvals.

networks.value: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, YouTube, WordPress, Threads and Bluesky

api.value: API access is arranged through sales rather than self-serve, and the white-label article says only SSO integration is supported through it today. No API tier appears on the pricing page

mcp.value: No MCP server is mentioned anywhere on Sendible's own site: not on the pricing or integrations pages, and a help-centre search for MCP returns nothing

ai.value: An AI Assist writing assistant with unlimited AI credits, listed on Core and inherited by every higher plan; no per-plan metering is published

teams.value: Unlimited users on every plan, including the cheapest. Assignment and approvals start on Plus, advanced permissions on Elite, SSO on Enterprise
